name: VisBrowse-Bench
description:
VisBrowse-Bench: Benchmarking Visual-Native Search for Multimodal Browsing Agents

Paper | GitHub
VisBrowse-Bench is a benchmark for visual-native search. It contains 169 VQA instances covering multiple domains and evaluates the models' visual reasoning capabilities during the search process through multimodal evidence cross-validation via text-image retrieval and joint reasoning.
